last_summary.worked: Implemented src/ball_packing_bounds.py, a reusable equal-ball packing calculator based on standard Cremona reduction. The code reproduced the classical small-k packing fractions exactly to numerical tolerance, including 3/4 for k=3, 20/25 for k=5, 24/25 for k=6, 63/64 for k=7, 288/289 for k=8, and full packing for k>=9. For k=10 it computed the full-packing infimum capacity mu=sqrt(10), and for every tested eps the task target mu=sqrt(10/(1-eps)) was already reduced with positive square. This shows the task regime k>=10 has no abstract packing obstruction. It also quantified the constructive gap: the audited repository Hamiltonian has effective mu about 28.415, roughly 9x the theoretical full-packing threshold sqrt(10).
